# Module name = folder name
get_filename_component(MODULE_NAME ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} NAME)

# Collect sources from custom and generated folders
file(GLOB_RECURSE CUSTOM_SOURCES
    CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/custom/*.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/custom/*.cpp
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/custom/*.h
)

file(GLOB_RECURSE GENERATED_SOURCES
    CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated1/*.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated1/*.cpp
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated1/*.h
)

# Combine all sources
set(ALL_SOURCES
    ${CUSTOM_SOURCES}
    ${GENERATED_SOURCES}
)

# Create object library (good for embedded)
# add_library(${MODULE_NAME} OBJECT ${ALL_SOURCES})
add_library(${MODULE_NAME}  ${ALL_SOURCES})

target_link_libraries(${MODULE_NAME} PUBLIC stm32cubemx
    lvgl
)
# Include directories
target_include_directories(${MODULE_NAME} PUBLIC
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Lib/ThirdParty
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Lib/MyLib
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/custom
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated1
)
